reviews.title: Great value and solid performance
reviews.comment: This TEAMGROUP T-Force Vulcan Z 1TB SSD has been a great upgrade with fast performance, reliable everyday use, and plenty of storage, making it an excellent value for anyone looking to improve load times and overall system responsiveness.
reviews.author: Alexander Kazanski

reviews.title: Strong work force
reviews.comment: Purchased in 2023 at 142.99 and they are going on 3yrs old and still running strong, all four of them and 16 total terabytes with still plenty of room for all my movies and tv shows. Amazing how much the price has went up on silicon. We have data centers to thank for the increase. Happy I purchased mine when I did. Highly recommend the Teamgroup T Force Vulcan Z
reviews.author: chris

reviews.title: Poor Chip Quality. TeamGroup Lied.
reviews.comment: Amazing Shipping from Amazon Prime as ALWAYS!!! Amazon fulfilled their Promise getting my SSD to me plenty time early install Wind10 Pro "22H2" in time for the Microsoft's Oktober 1 Year Extended Update Dead-Line. (Salute) However, TeamGroup is "Defrauding" Consumers and Stealing Money! I LOST RESPECT FOR TeamGroup! How dare TeamGroup sale this GARBAGE with a "Pretty Label". WHERE TO START: First, Advertised @ 550/470. ACTUALLY @ 402/343 (20% Loss) Industry Standard: +/- 5% (25 MB/s) 400% LOSS Higher than Competitors!!! Second, VulcanZ "QLC" is OVERPRICED @ $65 for 400/350 MB/s I would give a Fair Market Price around $41.99 (No Higher) Third, NOW Customer(s) HAVE TO WIPE DRIVE or BUY COMPETITOR'S then CLONE. Either way... Customer(s) have to CHOOSE Lose:  DATA or  MONEY/TIME or...  ALL THREE!!! Fourth, This SSD was Tested "ROCK SOLID", STABLE, and ZERO Thermal Issues. There are ZERO Defects. Just PURE LIES to the Consumer!!! Poor "Quality" Chips. This SSD WILL FAIL FAST under Normal Use in no time at all. It is NOT meant for Gaming AT ALL. Nor would I "Recommend" you to put an Operating System on this drive. I don't know if I would even Recommend Simple Back Up Storage. I DOUBT I would even Recommend THIS "QLC" SSD PERIOD. ***Even if YOUR SSD hits Manufacturers 550/470 for "QLC"... It is a "Matter of Time" before "THESE TeamGroup Chips" start to Fail FAST! Literally: A "NON-BRANDED" SDD would destroy "THIS" SSD. No lie or exaggeration. HORRIBLE Quality Control from TeamGroup. HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED in you TeamGroup! I "LOVED" TeamGroup... Not NO MORE. Used Team Group for Years NOW. Back to Western Digital for ME!!!
